'''Keet''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] used for wall panels. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] had keet-panel walls in [[Gender/Legends|her]] quarters inside her [[The Home|asteroid hideout]].
